text:
zoe: FYI from CISO — propose hard limit on eu-south audit exports to reduce S3 egress. Suggested approach: keep auth/grant events full, sample noisy keystore/enrichment events to 20%. Need ops/security risk check.

omar: Why eu-south specifically? Are we seeing a disproportionate spend there?

zoe: Yep — our eu-south region uses older exporter config (no compression + full JSON) and is ~1.9TB/day. Newer regions are ~300-400GB/day.

lucy: Danger: eu-south GPU onboarding is fragile. When we sampled in a prior run we missed repeated KMS 502s that correlated with node joins failing. Sampling + firewall tightening could blind us.

ops-oncall: Ops risk: agree. Must canary and add synthetic keystore decrypt probes, plus an auto-revert trigger. If decrypt_error_rate > 0.35% for 5m -> revert to 100% and page SRE.

zoe: Proposed canary plan: eu-south-1a at 50% for 48h with probes, then 25% for 72h if stable. Blacklist events containing fields: user_token, grant_id, cross_account, admin_action.

omar: Telemetry: add Prom rules for `keystore_decrypt_error_rate` and `keystore_decrypt_p99`. Also track `gpu_node_join_rate` and `join_latency_p95`.

ops-oncall: Runbook stub (will expand):
```
# set sampling for eu-south canary
kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch configmap audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-south-1a.keystore.sampling":"0.5"}}'
# probe
curl -fsS https://keystore-canary.eu-south-1a/api/v1/decrypt -d '{"test":"ping"}' || echo "probe-fail"
```
If probe fails 3x in 10m, patch back to 1.0 and page oncall. Also snapshot current raw logs to short-term bucket before canary.

lucy: Also recommend trying exporter changes first: enable snappy compression + event-level dedupe, then re-measure before sampling. That reduced payload by ~35% in us-west test.

omar: Compliance: we need a one-paragraph rationale for auditors that shows critical paths remain full and describes rehydration/rollback. Can security-bot open a ticket?

security-bot: Created SEC-2026-824. Assignees: zoe (owner), ops-oncall (runbook), omar (telemetry). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-824

zoe: Action items: omar -> prometheus rules + dashboard; ops-oncall -> full runbook + snapshot plan; lucy -> run exporter compression test in eu-south staging. Need compliance blurb by EOD.

ops-oncall: Will post runbook + CLI toggles to SEC-2026-824 in ~20m. We'll test rollback in staging first.

lucy: I'll run compression + dedupe tests and post numbers. If compression gets us >30% we can reduce sampling scope.

omar: I'll add auto-revert alert with Grafana panel and a small playbook to rehydrate if we need full logs for an investigation.

zoe: Thanks. If probes or join metrics regress at any point, revert immediately. Leaving SEC-2026-824 as canonical. :thumbsup:
